notes.title: Erdluitl - Build 14
notes.content:
[h1]Build 14[/h1]

This update solves various problems of the initial release, and adds new content based on first feedback and suggestions. It also brings tooltips and shortcuts to simplify gameplay. 

[h2]Additions :[/h2]
- Objectives and Diplomacy merged into a new unified UI display
- Encyclopedia with informations and lore about various aspects of the game
- Various UI improvements and tooltips added to clarify gameplay
- Options menu with customizable controls and audio levels
- Hotkeys added for most functions like Assault or Guard, etc...
- Escape key now cancels mouse commands, Possession spell and displays Menu
- Pause action triggered by Spacebar (Singleplayer only)

[h2]Gameplay balance :[/h2]
- Mana Projectile and Blizzard spells damage slightly decreased
- Heal spell cost slightly decreased
- Leveling stats slightly lowered

[h2]Fixes :[/h2]
 - Mission 9 Conch of Bubar fixed (quest items didn't spawn)
 - Creatures more reactive when spotting hostiles
 - Defending creatures not more stuck when following leader
 - King control fixed in Multiplayer
 - Other minor fixes...


[h1]Happy new year ![/h1]
